summary: Not approved. Jinshu 109 dates in this part rest on relative markers (其年, 明年, 於是, 初) without explicit reign years except 咸康七年. Checked against ZZTJ 卷096-097: the Goguryeo peace plea is 339 in ZZTJ (conflict with Jinshu's ≥340 order), Han's return and the raid are 340, Longcheng and the investiture are 341. Defects: point years from disputed 其年/明年, an 初 flashback merged with 340 events, unsupported 335 window starts on the Longcheng/investiture block, a 340 point year where Yu Liang's death is only a lower bound, Dou Wu/He Jin dated from a retrospective citation, and an unidentified 先帝. Six items and four hints are supported. No births, deaths or ages occur in owned units.

itemChecks.reason: 其年 is relative to the court's recognition story that follows Yu Liang's death (Jan 340), but ZZTJ 咸康五年 (AD 339) places this same Goguryeo campaign before that death; a bare point year 340 hides a conflicting witness.

findings.problem: 其年 in s0080 is placed after the Yu Liang/recognition narrative (≥340) but ZZTJ 咸康五年 (AD 339) dates the Goguryeo campaign and peace plea before Yu Liang's death; point year 340 hides conflicting witnesses.

findings.problem: 明年 in s0081 counts from the disputed 其年; ZZTJ does not record the heir's homage in 340/341 under that label.
findings.action: Mark unresolved with the dependency reason or a window covering both readings (340-341 vs 341-342); resync hints.

findings.problem: s0082-s0083 is an 初 flashback starting after Duan Liao's defeat (ZZTJ 咸康四年, 338); only Han's return is 340 (ZZTJ 咸康六年二月).
findings.action: Split: date the flight/hosting onOrAfter 338 and before the 340 return; date the return 340; resync p113/p114 hints.

findings.problem: Dou Wu and He Jin appear only as examples in Huang's letter; the 168/189 dates are their own deaths imported from outside, not attested here.
findings.action: Remove claim-618/623 as life attestations and add retrospective-reference events dated to the letter (onOrAfter 340), with subject role 'cited exemplar'; clear hints.

findings.problem: 先帝 in s0261 is unnamed; 323-325 is Emperor Ming's reign, not a dated grant.
findings.action: Research which emperor granted Huang a 列將 command and when; until then mark unresolved.

findings.action: Use westernBounds onOrAfter AD 340 (or interval 340-341 noting ZZTJ 341); resync p110 hint.
